text: The unit goal says 'Usuwa: przełącznik projektów w nagłówku' (remove the project switcher from the header), and the build notes call src/client/components/ProjectSwitcher.tsx removed. But at 2.1.58 the pages still declare it on the project route: M50 8h2a734u (after_change) says 'na trasie projektu zębatka prowadzi do strony ustawień projektu; obok nich stoi wpis slotu Nagłówek z nazwą projektu i przełącznikiem projektu', and the first M31 m31l5001 slot row (unchanged) says 'nazwa projektu z przełącznikiem … zawsze na trasie projektu'. The change in the window only adds a workspace-route slot row (workspace name + last-opened-project entry). Assumed: the pages at <to> win. The switcher leaves the workspace-route frame, where the slot shows the workspace name and the last-opened-project entry. It stays in the project-route header. If the intent was to remove it everywhere, M50 8h2a734u and the M31 slot table must drop it.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0701 project switcher removed only from the workspace-route frame; project-route header entry kept as M31 m31l5001 declares it at 2.1.58
